text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — prepping SEO checklist for next week's webinar + benchmark blog. Need quick alignment on keywords, schema, redirects, and internal linking. @Sam can you own keyword mapping? @Ajay can you run redirect matrix? Goal: finalize by Wed EOD. TL;DR below.

Sam Ortega: On it. I'll draft primary/secondary keyword groups and suggested meta titles. Can you share target audience and CTAs?

Maya Patel: Target: devs building LLM apps. CTAs: 'Start free trial', 'Request Dedicated demo', 'Download benchmark PDF'. Focus headings on latency, cost, and deployment options.

Sam Ortega: Got it. Tentative KW groups: "low-latency LLM inference", "inference cost optimization", "LLM deployment options", "dedicated GPU inference", "private VPC inference". I'll drop SERP intent buckets (informational vs commercial) in the doc.

Ajay Singh: Redirects note — we'll need to 301 legacy blog/case-study URLs into the benchmark and webinar landing. Any old webinar urls to retire?

Lina Chen: I found two legacy pages that should canonical -> benchmark: /blog/real-world-inference and /case-studies/latency. Also internal links from docs nav still point to the old case study; that'll need a nav patch.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Ajay, use this snippet for the redirect plan (copy into your PR):
```
301 /blog/real-world-inference /benchmarks/llm-inference-cost-performance
301 /case-studies/latency /benchmarks/llm-inference-cost-performance
301 /old-webinar /webinars/2026-inference-benchmark
```

Ajay Singh: Perfect — I'll open a redirect PR against netlify/_redirects and tag @eng-frontend for nav update. ETA Tue morning.

Sam Ortega: Also proposing JSON-LD for FAQ on the webinar landing + HowTo snippet for the benchmark guide. Example (very small):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {"@type": "Question", "name": "How does Redwood measure latency?", "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "P95 token-latency measured on steady-state workloads using a 1024 context."}}
  ]
}
```
(Full JSON-LD will go into the content doc.)

SEO-Bot: SEO check queued for /webinars/2026-inference-benchmark — will run after redirect PR is merged.

Lina Chen: I'll run an internal linking sweep: prioritize anchor text that includes primary KWs, add contextual links from docs and top-of-funnel blog posts. I’ll post the anchor list in #content once done.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — action items recap: Sam = KW + meta by Tue EOD; Ajay = redirect PR + netlify config Tue AM; Lina = link sweep + anchor list Wed AM. Sync Wed 10:00 to finalize. :thumbsup:

Sam Ortega: +1

Ajay Singh: Sounds good, opening PR now.

Lina Chen: On it, will surface any edge cases (legacy canonical tags, pagination).

Maya Patel: If anyone spots a URL not in the redirect snippet above, drop it here and I’ll add to the list.
